decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The Sales Centre shall be erected for a temporary period only, with it to be entirely removed by October 2016. Following removal of the Sales Centre the land shall be landscaped in accordance with the approved landscape details for the site.

Condition : 2 - Four car parking spaces shall be allocated at all times on the site for the exclusive use by the Sales Centre visitors. Two spaces shall be allocated on the public square for disabled car parking spaces for the Sales Centre.

Condition : 3 - During servicing and demolition of the Sales Centre, no vehicles shall park/load/unload/wait/pick up/ drop off on the TLRN public highway of A205 at any time. No skip/demolition materials shall be kept on the carriageway or footway of the A205 at any time.
Condition : 4 - No servicing/demolition vehicles shall enter/exit the site/access road by reversing to/from the main carriageway of the A205.
Condition : 5 - The Sales Centre hereby permitted shall not be occupied as a dwelling.

Condition : 6 - The area marked red and designated 'Public Open Space Area Increase' totalling 18,820 sq ft, on drawing number 29049-L-PH3-SK011-C2, shall be completed in accordance with the approved landscaping details for the site and made available to the public by October 2014.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (Temporary period) of permission 00657/P/P15 dated 17.09.2010 to remove "occupation of 80% of the private residential units on the site (as approved under planning permission 00657/P/P13)", with the sales centre to be removed in its entirety by October 2016
